properties.name: summary_endovier_extraction
properties.narrative: Celaena is removed from Endovier, tested by royal power, and recruited into a competition that converts imprisonment into conditional service.
atomic_facts: Dorian offers Celaena a route out of slavery.
Celaena accepts a champion bargain tied to future freedom.
properties.foresight: This event creates the core status-revision chain that will dominate the rest of the graph.

properties.name: summary_rifthold_arrival
properties.narrative: The journey to Rifthold hardens court boundaries around Celaena, while the glass castle, the clock tower, and the library reveal that knowledge and atmosphere matter as much as steel.
atomic_facts: Celaena notices Wyrdmarks around the clock tower.
The royal library becomes a strategic and emotional refuge.
properties.foresight: The castle will evolve from a prisonlike setting into the central stage for both political and magical escalation.

properties.name: summary_champion_training
properties.narrative: The champion trials expose Cain as the most dangerous rival and reveal Chaol's mix of discipline, distrust, and reluctant investment in Celaena's survival.
atomic_facts: Cain emerges as the competition's strongest visible threat.
Court violence intensifies around the champion tests.
properties.foresight: Repeated exposure to danger will turn training into trust and rivalry into something darker.

properties.name: summary_nehemia_and_magic
properties.narrative: Nehemia's arrival opens a political and emotional alliance for Celaena, while Elena's warnings and the poison test confirm that hidden magic is reshaping the competition.
atomic_facts: Nehemia becomes Celaena's friend and political mirror.
Elena warns Celaena that danger is moving through the castle.
The competition is being manipulated beyond normal court rivalry.
properties.foresight: Friendship and mythic knowledge will converge during the final duel.

properties.name: summary_final_duel
properties.narrative: The final duel fuses personal rivalry, political symbolism, and forbidden magic: Nehemia's staff, Elena's intervention, Chaol's lethal choice, and Celaena's victory all collapse into a single turning point.
atomic_facts: Nehemia arms Celaena with an Eyllwe staff.
Cain's power is revealed as unnatural.
Chaol kills Cain and Celaena wins the title.
properties.foresight: The new title stabilizes Celaena's status but deepens the graph's unresolved magical and political tensions.
